subject: Arcadia Labs — CIO briefing: attendance, recording preference, and backup coverage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@arcadialabs.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@arcadialabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Arcadia Labs — CIO briefing: attendance, recording preference, and backup coverage

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We'd love to hold a short executive briefing/demo next week to show the part of the platform that maps to Arcadia's latency and multi-tenant isolation asks. Two quick questions to help us finalize logistics:

1) Who from your leadership will join the 30-minute slot (VP/CIO/CTO)?
2) Do you want the session recorded? If so, any restrictions (internal-only, redact PII, no sharing)?

We can do either of these windows (PT):
- Wed Apr 6, 10:00–10:30am PT
- Thu Apr 7, 2:00–2:30pm PT

I've attached a short agenda (Agenda_v1.pdf) — focused on: 1) 10-min executive overview + 15-min demo + 5-min Q&A.

If you prefer a different cadence, happy to adapt. Assuming a CIO-level attendee, we can tighten the demo to highlight high-level SLA/cost controls.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: Agenda_v1.pdf]

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@arcadialabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@arcadialabs.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Arcadia Labs — CIO briefing: attendance, recording preference, and backup coverage

Ben —

Thanks — Tom (CIO) will join. Sally Li (VP Infra) might also be able to hop on but she's away for a portion of Thu. Our preference is:

- 30-minute slot is ideal (we prefer concise).
- Prefer the session NOT be recorded or shared externally. If a recording is necessary, it needs to be marked internal-only and we will review redaction.

Can we do Wed Apr 6, 10:00–10:30am PT? That works for Tom.

Also attaching a short internal note for context (Prospect_intro_notes.docx).

Emily
Emily Zhao | Senior Product Ops
Arcadia Labs
emily.zhao@arcadialabs.com
[Attachment: Prospect_intro_notes.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@arcadialabs.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@arcadialabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-28T12:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Arcadia Labs — CIO briefing: attendance, recording preference, and backup coverage

Emily —

Great — Wed Apr 6 at 10:00–10:30am PT is confirmed on our side. Appreciate the note on recording. Here's how we can handle it so everyone is comfortable:

- We'll do the live 30-min session with Tom and Sally.
- We can record for internal Redwood use only, and we will not publish externally without your explicit sign-off.
- If Arcadia prefers, we'll redact any slides that include screenshots of customer data and mark the file as "internal only" in our drive.

If you'd rather we don't record at all, we will respect that. Please let us know NOW so we set the meeting settings accordingly.

Operational note: if Ben (me) is pulled last-minute, Lauren Bishop (cc'd) will step into the exec portion. If Lauren is unavailable, Karthik Iyer will cover the architecture/ops overview.

I've attached an updated agenda and a provisional SLA draft for high-level discussion (Agenda_v2.pdf, SLA_Draft.docx). Also: https://cal.example.com/meeting/1a2b3c — calendar invite will be sent after you confirm recording preference.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Agenda_v2.pdf, SLA_Draft.docx]

Ben / Lauren —

Quick note from infra side: happy to provide the 10–15 minute technical pre-brief with our internal team at 9:40am PT (20 minutes before the exec demo) so we can align on the demo scope and redaction approach. Will that work for Arcadia?

-Karthik

Confirmed — I will join Apr 6 at 10:00am PT. We prefer no public distribution of the recording; internal sharing is OK provided Redwood's team flags any sections with customer data and we agree on redaction prior to distribution.

9:40am internal pre-brief works for us as well — Emily, I'll forward to our security lead if we need sign-off on the redaction process.
